background_signature_screen.limitation: No matching signature does not exclude shared underlying HIJING; source configuration/campaign links unavailable

partition.rule: For nonempty background, (EventKey(BACKGROUND_NAMESPACE,count,signatureSum,signatureXor) XOR seed) modulo 2; for empty background EventKey(POOL_NAMESPACE,run,lumi,event) fallback. 0=A,1=B
partition.file_list_warning: A/B lists intentionally share source paths; selecting all file entries violates partition. Apply seeded observed-background signature fold (physical-ID fallback only for empty backgrounds) or authoritative ledger.
